label: The earlier-date reason theorem tests what the inertial branch supplies to the momentary PSR
note: Origin-or-inertia meets the momentary PSR through its earlier-date branch, with no giver after onset. The theorem applies that branch under the cessation law: every successful earlier-date reason for presence at t carries the same bearer's presence at s. It tests the scope of what the reason supplies, not the truth of the PSR.
